review.why: Review copy against your brand voice, style guide and messaging pillars, with severity-ranked fixes and a legal and compliance check.
review.summary: Takes the content and, when available, the brand guidelines; checks voice, terminology, messaging pillars and style; always flags unsubstantiated claims, missing disclaimers, comparative claims and testimonial issues; returns a summary, a findings table with severity, revised sections and legal flags. It also carries frameworks for documenting a brand voice.
strengths: Works with or without a style guide: without one it falls back to a clarity, consistency and professionalism review.
Compliance flags are checked every time and kept separate from style findings.
The voice framework (we are, we are not, sounds like) and the tone-by-channel and tone-by-situation tables are directly reusable.
cautions: Written as a command with optional connectors marked by ~~ placeholders, and it points to a CONNECTORS.md outside the skill folder.
Legal and compliance flags are prompts for a person to check, not legal advice.
The repository's LICENSE file is the Apache-2.0 text followed by unrelated stray text, so the license shows as unclear although GitHub detects Apache-2.0. Read in full but not run here.
